content:
Overview

Burlington is a city in VT with a population of 44,743. Lake Champlain college town with Ben & Jerry’s, craft beer, and progressive politics. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4b growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The population skews young, with a median age of 26.7.
